EpochMs.description: UTC milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

type.description: A relative URI reference (RFC 9457) that ends with `code`. GET it on the same server for a plain description.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the request body.

labels.description: What the country calls its levels, in libaddressinput's words (province, state, nation ...); null when it has none.

mileage.description: The country has published mileage rates.

tax.description: The country has a tax estimate and comma.tax_countries does not hide it.

verified.description: False until a person has checked the figures against the primary sources.

work.description: Kinds of platform work the country's data covers (plan 21 section 3.6a). With one kind, onboarding does not ask (plan 23).

regional_rules.description: Some region or city has its own rules, so setting the region can change results.

WorkKind.description: Location-based platform work (plan 21 section 3.6a): food or parcel delivery, ride-hailing, motorcycle taxi, courier.

code.description: A region: the ISO 3166-2 part after the country, as settings.region stores it (ON). A city: its full code (US-NY-NYC).

own_rules.description: This place has data that differs from the level above.

verified.description: True only if every level that supplies data was checked by a person.

Modules.description: Read-only module flags so clients can hide screens and buttons of absent modules.

earnings.description: Earnings module registered (18 section 4.3): the driver can type a total per shift and platform.

receipts.description: Receipts module registered (18 section 5.4); needs expenses.

tax.description: Tax module registered (18 section 7). The estimate itself exists only for countries whose pack is verified or switched on.

import.description: Import module registered (18 section 12). The expenses kind also needs the expenses module.

local_export.description: Reserved for v1.1; false in v1.

stops.description: Effective flag: the stops module is registered AND settings.stops_enabled is true. When false the phone and the web hide every stop and estimated-split element.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics module registered (16). When false the phone behaves as level off and the web hides the Diagnostics screens.

capture.description: Capture module registered (16 section 8); false by default.

engine_version.description: The server's track-engine algorithmVersion (14 section 11). A phone with a lower number still shows its own result until sync.

stops_enabled.description: Driver-facing toggle for auto-detected stops, the estimated active/deadhead split and web labelling (decision 1.5b). Default true. Captured per shift at shift start (Shift.segmenter), so changing it never alters an existing shift.

help_enabled.description: The owner's switch for the Help pages in the web app and the help links on screens. Default true. Web only; the server has no help module (ADR 0002).

region.description: Subdivision code without the country (CA: ON, QC ...); validated by the country pack.

logbook.description: What the tax office of the driver's country and region asks of odometer records (plan 21 logbook slot), for the Odometer screen. null when the country has no such rule; readings are then optional.

own_mileage_rate.description: Your mileage rate in force today (plan 21 Q5, ADR 0007), or null. The dated list is GET /own-mileage-rates. It values mileage where the country has no official rates, and replaces them from its date when use_own_mileage_rate is true.

mileage_rate.description: Which rate values mileage driven today: the country's published rates, the driver's own (screens and exports label it "your rate", never official), or none. Older shifts may differ by date: Shift.deduction_rate says which valued each.

use_own_mileage_rate.description: ADR 0007: your mileage rates replace the country's from their dates. Default false. Without country rates your rate applies anyway.

default_vehicle_id.description: Preselected when a shift starts; always an active vehicle.

work_kinds.description: The work the driver does, among what the country offers. When none is chosen and the country offers one kind, that kind (plan 23 rule 1).

onboarded_at.description: When the driver finished the web onboarding (plan 23); null while it is not finished, so the web opens it.

setup_done.description: Dashboard "Finish setting up" steps the driver finished or skipped. A listed step stays done even if, say, the phone is unpaired later.

diagnostics_level.description: verbose reverts to basic after 7 days (16 section 5).

region.description: A new country clears a region it does not have.

own_mileage_rate.description: Sets (or with null removes) your undated rate, "from the start" (ADR 0007). Dated rates are kept in /own-mileage-rates.

use_own_mileage_rate.description: true: your mileage rates replace the country's from their dates (ADR 0007).

work_kinds.description: Only kinds the country offers (422 otherwise); a new country drops the kinds it does not offer.

onboarded.description: true: onboarding finished (sets onboarded_at, keeping an earlier time); false: run it again (clears onboarded_at and setup_done).

setup_done.description: Steps to add to setup_done; steps already listed are kept (it never removes one).

cents_per_unit.description: Minor units of the currency per km or mile; hundredths are kept (30.5).

DatedOwnMileageRate.description: One of your mileage rates (ADR 0007): in force from effective_from until the next rate. Shown as "your rate", never as an official rate.

effective_from.description: The first local date it values; null means from the start (the undated rate set before rates had dates).

cents_per_unit.description: Minor units of the currency per km or mile; hundredths are kept (72.5).

note.description: Where the figure comes from, for example "Employer reimbursement 2026".

effective_from.description: A calendar date; one rate per day. null: from the start (at most one).

clock_skew_ms.description: Last observed phone-minus-server clock difference; in memory only.

VehicleKind.description: bicycle, ebike, scooter and walking are not automobiles: no mileage allowance rate applies (18 section 4.1).

VehicleOwnership.description: Who owns the vehicle (21 section 3.6c). owned: the driver owns it. financed: the driver is buying it with instalments (car loan, hire purchase, drive-to-own). leased: a fixed-term contract; the vehicle goes back at the end. rented: short-term, by the day, week or month. A record only: no tax rule reads it.

plate.description: The driver's own record; never exported unless the driver ticks it.

logo_version.description: Changes when the driver's uploaded logo changes; null: no logo (plan 25 section 7). The image is GET /platforms/{slug}/logo?v=<logo_version>.

ShiftEarningsPut.description: Omitted amounts are 0 and omitted counts are null, because the row is replaced.

orders.description: The platform's own count for the shift

items.description: One row per platform. Every amount is the sum of its entries with their signs (plan 22 section 3.3).

fees_cents.description: Commission and platform fees; 0 or below.

total_cents.description: Earnings: gross + tips + bonus + fees + adjustments.

tax_withheld_cents.description: 0 or below; not part of earnings.

cash_collected_cents.description: 0 or below; cash in the driver's hand

balance_cents.description: Sum of all entries; below 0 means the driver owes the platform.

EarningEntryType.description: Plan 22 section 3.2. Above 0: fare, tip, bonus, top_up. Below 0: cash_collected, commission, platform_fee, tax_withheld, payout. Either sign: adjustment.

amount_cents.description: Minor units, signed: the effect on what the platform owes the driver. Never 0.

tax_credit_cents.description: Input tax credit portion (HST/GST/VAT); not more than the amount.

recurrence.description: Makes the row a reminder template, not an expense. Needs next_due.

tax_credit_cents.description: Input tax credit portion (HST/GST/VAT); not more than the amount.

recurrence.description: Makes the row a reminder template, not an expense. Needs next_due.

deductible_cents.description: Computed at read time: amount x business % rounded half up, 0 when not deductible.

double_counts.description: A standard-mileage vehicle's rate already covers this category; saved and warned about

target_cents.description: Gross earnings times the set-aside rate; null without earnings.

supported.description: False when the country has no switched-on pack; then income

unverified.description: True while the pack's figures have not been compared with the primary publications; the screen shows an "unverified rates" notice.

pays_instalments.description: The driver's own choice for this tax year

instalments_note.description: Who the tax office asks for instalments

sales_tax_name.description: The sales tax of the driver's place from the country data (GST, HST), for the "Registered for ..." choice; null when none is known.

income.description: Effective earnings of the year; null when none were entered or labelled.

fees_cents.description: Commission and platform fees (plan 22), 0 or below; already taken off total_cents.

adjustments_cents.description: Corrections to pay; part of total_cents.

tax_withheld_cents.description: Tax the platforms kept, 0 or below; not part of total_cents and not yet subtracted from the estimate.

expenses_cents.description: null when the expenses module is off.

mileage_rate.description: Which rate valued mileage_cents (ADR 0007); yours and mixed are never presented as official.

lines.description: The amounts to set aside, as the country's tax pack computes them (CA, pension contribution, second band, income tax at the set-aside rate). They add up to total_set_aside_cents.

cents.description: null when not estimated here; note says why.

double_counts.description: The linked expense is covered by the vehicle's standard mileage rate.

problems.description: Every row with a problem, in file order, up to 1000; summary.error is the full count.

drive_count.description: Drive lines read after the header (totals and footer lines are not drives).

classes.description: Drives by MileIQ category. other = medical, charity, moving and any other category: imported as personal.

distance_m.description: Distance of the drives that would be imported.

unit.description: The distance unit of the file (its MILES or KM column).

date_order_source.description: file: a date in the file shows the order; country: every date fits both, the server country decided; chosen: the date_order parameter.

value_ignored.description: The file has MileIQ's value columns; they are not read, MileWage works out its own deduction.

name.description: The VEHICLE text of the file; null when blank or unspecified.

vehicle_id.description: The vehicle the drives go to; null when none (those drives are errors).

matched.description: True when a vehicle of yours has this name; false: your default vehicle is used.

expenses.description: Expenses that would be written (parking and tolls of business drives).

left_out.description: Drives whose parking or tolls are not imported (not business

segmenter.description: The phone sends the value it read from its cached settings (stops_enabled). Omitted (an older phone): the server uses the current setting at receipt.
stops = active_m and deadhead_m are ESTIMATES from detected stops (clients label them so); whole_shift = one active segment. total_m is the same either way.

deduction_cents.description: Computed at read time from the country registry; never stored.

deduction_rate.description: Which rate valued deduction_cents (ADR 0007): the country's, or your mileage rate in force on the shift's date (always labelled "your rate"). null when there is no value.

overlaps_shift_id.description: Set when a late upload made this shift overlap another (15 section 9.2).

code.description: One of the flags in 14 section 8.

data.description: The entity in its API shape; null for delete.

Route.description: Parallel arrays of equal length. speed_dmps is null-filled for archived routes.

trip.description: Null only for a trip override whose trip_key matches no trip (reported as override_orphaned).

Stop.description: A derived stop (14 section 6). Never written by a client.

est_role.description: The engine's estimate; none = recorded but does not change the estimate.

stop.description: Null only when DELETE cleared a label whose stop no longer exists (label_orphaned).

rejected.description: Permanently refused points. Everything not listed here is stored.

upload_hint_s.description: Suggested seconds until the next upload (60).

earnings_cents.description: Effective earnings (18 section 4.3) - the driver's typed totals

deduction_cents.description: null when the selected country has no registered pack.

deduction_rate.description: Which rate valued the period's deduction (ADR 0007): the country's, your own, or both by date (mixed). null when there is no value.

hourly_earnings_cents.description: earnings_cents divided by hours; null when hours is 0.

platform_filter.description: Present only when the platform query was given.

start.description: The bucket's first day (the first of the month by month).

earnings_cents.description: As Summary.earnings_cents; null when the bucket has shifts but nothing entered or labelled, or nothing can count as earnings. 0 with no shifts and no earnings.

unsplit_m.description: Business distance of shifts with no stop-based split; it is counted in active_m. The rest of active_m and deadhead_m are estimates from detected stops.

platforms.description: Earnings per platform in the bucket, largest first.

recovery_key.description: age private key; never stored on the server.

backup.description: The first backup under the new key, or null when it failed (the key change stands; run a backup again).

last_backup_failure.description: The last backup run, when it failed and no run has succeeded since. Failed runs make no backup, so they are not in GET /backups. Kept in memory, so a restart clears it.

diagnostics.description: Present when the diagnostics module is on (16 section 7.2).

verbose_until.description: Epoch ms; verbose reverts to basic then.

capture.description: For a device, its own active capture session; always null for a web session.

seq.description: Required for phone sources; strictly increasing per (device

data.description: Typed fields defined per kind in the shared package registry (16 section 3.2). Unknown fields are rejected. Never a coordinate, address, payout, label or free text (16 section 4).

discarded.description: Verbose events accepted but not stored because disk is low.

id.description: H1 to H7 (device checks) or S1 to S5 (server checks), 16 section 10.1.

weight.description: Points toward the 0 to 100 score; absent for server checks.

shift.description: Shift client_id the fixes belong to.

text.description: Free text; capture data is not diagnostics and may contain it (16 section 8.2).
